FOLD-A POOL = 288, not 306 (needs coordinator acknowledgement before FA starts): DECL-D3-A1 item 2 asks for the 306 PRIMARY text tiles AND renders on crops >= 144 vox from J. 18 of the 306 tiles (w00 4, 214732 11, 022814 3) have mesh-valid pixels 128-144 vox from a J mesh point (3-D distance histogram [128,132) 1, [132,136) 9, [136,140) 7, [140,144) 1). Rendering them would put -n 31 slab voxels (+-15 vox) closer than 128 vox to J, so they were not rendered. 288 >= 280 (the DECL-D3D4 feasibility floor). CTRL runs first and uses no fold-A data, so a decision can be made during CTRL (about 1.7 h).

Replay pool = 2643 tiles, below the 3000 cap: DECL-D3-A1 does not set a tile grid; the official base-training patch grid (stride 32) was used and gives only 2643 tiles with >= 90 % supervised pixels (w035 540, w039 305, w040 756, w041 321, w044 721). The quota rule (600 per segment, shortfall re-split equally) therefore takes every candidate, so seed 20260925 only orders the draw.

578 of the 721 w044 replay tiles overlap the D1 canary organizer window (y0 2816, x0 2816, 2136 px). w044 is base-training papyrus (one of the 5 native representations) and DECL-D3-A1 does not exclude it: reported only.
Replay labels: the 20260918 native label set is 2-D uint8 (0/255) on each mesh canvas (grid x 20). Ink-label pixels outside supervision are treated as unsupervised (ignored).

Trainer: the official train.py inner step run without Accelerate, as declared: fp32, CPU, 3 threads, data prepared in-process (0 loader workers). Extra import dependencies of the official augmentation and training modules come from /work/d3_timing/pylib (--no-deps target, outside the validated /opt/hv-ink venv).

Sampling (not specified in DECL-D3-A1): epoch-wise permutation streams (no replacement within an epoch) from two child seeds of SeedSequence(20260925), one fold-A and one replay. Batch = 4 fold-A then 4 replay (CTRL: 8 replay). FA, NULLA and REVA see the identical tile, jitter and augmentation sequence (paired arms).

REVA reverses each stored 21-slice fold-A stack (render slices 25..5), then the official window/jitter applies: REVA with offset o equals the exact depth reverse of FA with offset -o (verified in the smoke test). The official 'default' augmentation mirrors, rotates and transposes only in-plane (axes 1, 2), so it never undoes the reversal.

Saved per arm: model_final.pth = {model (final weights), config (the base checkpoint's embedded config, unchanged, so the official infer rebuilds the same model and normalisation), step 2000, d3 metadata}; no optimizer state.

Renders: fold-A tiles use one 128 x 128 crop per tile; replay uses one bounding-box crop per connected component of the selected tiles (30 crops, 0139 only). vc_render_tifxyz output is crop-invariant: a 128 px tile render was identical to the matching subregion of the 384 px timing crop (0 differing voxels).
